ges102.title: African Cultures and Civilisation: A textbook for GES 102
ges102.publisher: Ibadan University Press (Centre for General Studies)

africa-and-early-humans.read: Chapter 1, Africa and the Early Humans
africa-and-early-humans.why: The course textbook, in the course folder.

early-centres-of-civilisation.read: Chapter 2 (Egypt, Kush and Axum) and Chapter 6 (Roman Civilisation in Africa)
early-centres-of-civilisation.why: Dates and achievements the tests ask about.

indigenous-political-systems.why: The family, the four types of political system and kingship.

religion-in-africa.read: Chapters 4, 7 and 8 (African Religion and Culture; Christianity in Africa; Islam in Africa)
religion-in-africa.why: The five beliefs, the centres of Christianity and the spread of Islam.

indigenous-education.read: Chapter 5, Indigenous African Education: Nigeria Experience
indigenous-education.why: Fafunwa's objectives and the methods of learning.

environment-communication-and-language.read: Chapters 9 and 10 (Environment and Culture; Communication, Language and Culture in Africa)
environment-communication-and-language.why: Definitions and the components of communication.

colonialism-nigeria-and-gender.read: Chapters 11 and 12 (Culture Dynamics in the Age of Colonialism; Gender and African Cultures)
colonialism-nigeria-and-gender.why: Key dates in Nigeria's evolution and the gender concepts.
